reason: YouTube with a 30-minute timer already works for me and costs nothing. I might try the free 14 days since there's no auto-payment, but at the end I'd probably just keep the free version or go back to YouTube, not pay 4,900 won a month.
objection: Honestly I don't wake up and want the sound back that often, and the free tier already gives me a 30/60 minute timer, which is basically what I do now. Good that it only comes back when I press the button, but I'm not paying monthly for a timer that adjusts itself.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 record clearly showed I fall asleep 10+ minutes faster than with my YouTube routine, and it were a one-time payment of around 10,000 won instead of a subscription.
